criteria.altloc_clash_partition: per-neighbor min over protein altloc states; labeled waters match assigned A/B; unlabeled waters use occupancy-scaled cutoff
criteria.conformer_matching: Hungarian optimal one-to-one A/B assignment; maximize valid matches then minimize total conventional RMSD
criteria.merge_method: A/B-protected single-linkage connected components; protected anchor or occupancy-weighted medoid geometry; summed cluster occupancy
criteria.rotamer_gate: shared residue/chi centers and per-chi widths
criteria.tmol_gate: no worse than matched deposited conformer
